entry.title: Boss ordered to pay $47k after visa threats and abusive texts
entry.summary: A Wellington employer who threatened to report a migrant tattoo artist to immigration after he took sick leave must pay $40,000 in compensation.

entry.title: Builder told worker to sort own tax over visa status before serious work fall
entry.summary: Chenjia Ye fell heavily onto a roof beam while working for B&D Pro Construction, which claimed his visa status meant he was a contractor.

entry.title: Hello summer! Canterbury back in firing line for more thunderstorms
entry.summary: The weather system, embedded in an incoming flow, is moving across the northern South Island and southern North Island, bringing an active front throughout Friday.
